name: Core Passive: Sky Knight
Additional Ability: Sky Alliance
desc:
<color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack]</color> Phase 4, <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Assist Follow-Up]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Chain Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Ultimate]</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>[Dodge Counter]</color> are considered <color=#FFFFFF>[Drawn Stance]</color>;
When Sigrid uses any <color=#FFFFFF>[Drawn Stance]</color> in combat, if not currently in <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Stance]</color>, she enters <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Stance]</color> and gains 1 charge of <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Holster Stance]</color>, up to a maximum of 1 charge;
In combat, while in <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Stance]</color>, when Sigrid uses any <color=#FFFFFF>[Drawn Stance]</color>, she can refresh <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Stance]</color> and gain 1 charge of <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Holster Stance]</color>, up to a maximum of 1 charge;
The duration of <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Stance]</color> decreases as the <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Holster Stance]</color> phase increases: at Phase 1/2/3, the duration is <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>7</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>6</color>s respectively;
When <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Stance]</color> ends, the <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Holster Stance]</color> phase decreases by 1, down to a minimum of Phase 1;
When activating or refreshing <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Stance]</color>, Sigrid's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>33%</color> and her ATK increases by <color=#FFFFFF>150%</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s; on repeated triggers, the duration is extended by <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s, up to a maximum of <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>s;
When Sigrid's attacks hit an enemy in a Stunned state, the Stun DMG Multiplier dealt to the target increases by 20%.

1.name: A long, long time ago,
1.desc: When the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Gun Retraction]</color> is triggered, enter or refresh <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunstance]</color> and gain one opportunity to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Gun Retraction]</color>; excess <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Gun Retraction]</color> opportunities cause the next <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Gun Retraction]</color> to deal an extra <color=#FFFFFF>150%</color> DMG; Sigrid's own ATK increases by <color=#FFFFFF>22%</color>.
1.desc2:
Long, long ago, the great Sunbringer scooped up the very first handful of earth on the sky islands…
Hold on, hold on — the kids have heard the story of Lady Sunbringer building the first island of Roscaelifer so many times their ears have grown calluses.
What we're here to talk about today is the story of the warrior who stood at Lady Sunbringer's side — clad in silver-white armor as radiant as a moonlit night, just like a Knight of old from a fairy tale…

2.name: Act One of the Legendary
2.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Holster Stance]</color> deal <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> that ignores <color=#FFFFFF>24%</color> of the target's <color=#FFFFFF>DEF</color>; the duration of the <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> effect is extended by 2s;
2.desc2:
She was Roscaelifer's first Soldier, its first spear — standing at the first line of defense against the Hollow, leading the first charge.
She was the first wing to follow Lady Sunbringer, and with her own hands raised the first walls of Roscaelifer.
She was the first blade of Roscaelifer to be broken. Her name was de L'Azur.
Her children, like her legend, burn eternal in the night sky over Roscaelifer.

4.name: Hero Upgrading
4.desc: Each time <color=#FFFFFF>[Aerial Gunstance]</color> refreshes, increase the DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>20%</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s. Repeated triggers can extend the duration by <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s, up to a maximum of <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>s.

6.name: Knight of the Skies
6.desc: <color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack: Gun Draw]</color> The first hit on an enemy in the 1st/2nd/3rd stage deals an additional <color=#FFFFFF>200%</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>300%</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>400%</color> DMG.
